root_cause: After migration-history parity PR #4087 protected-merged as 1856cfb28e85128c1e526a5c53c457a53b39dd5c, production and GitHub were proven 634/634 with zero local-only and zero remote-only migration versions. The canonical terminalizer still failed because supabase/migration-history.lock.json was left in the generic non-governance path set. The runtime classifier correctly found no Edge Function, SQL migration or Netlify deployment for that lock file and therefore emitted UNWIRED_NON_NETLIFY_RUNTIME_READBACK. The lock is immutable verifier evidence, not executable runtime.
prevention: Classify supabase/migration-history.lock.json centrally in production-readback-v1 as verifier-only evidence.
Do not classify the supabase/ or supabase/migrations/ prefixes as verifier-only; executable SQL migrations must continue to require provider APPLIED readback.
Regression-test the lock-file exception in the same canonical terminalizer governance suite.
